page.layout: One printed page, left part only: running head at top; below it a ruled table of years and names, with the names in column 1 and the year at the left of each group; the table is cut off at the right edge; below the table, small italic notes in full lines, cut off at the right edge.; One column of main text, right of centre, with short italic summary paragraphs, the last one in roman type running to the foot. Page number at the top right. No running head, catchword or signature. Left-edge fragments at the border are not transcribed.

p.i: Denuo cognitio controversiæ institu-ta Novesij, actore Saxone, reis Edsar-do & Groningani.
Idem repetitum Coloniæ præsente ac præside ipso Maximil. Cæsare.
Gerbrandus Moccama, & Gemma Iuwsma capite multati Leoardiæ.
† Actio de reconciliatione inter partes Monasterij: & alia Adoardiæ.
‡ Edsardus, item Groningani proscripti. Bellū atrox cis ultraque Amasum illatum. Dammona à Saxonibus vi capta. Groninga Iuris Geldrici facta.

main_text.p: § Ius Frisicū a Georgio Saxone in Carolum Burgund. pr. Geldros in Frisia occid. Doccumum a Burgundis & Burgundicis reconciliatio Sneca obsessa. Longus Geldricis recepsum.

page.notes: Lines cut off at the right edge of the scan: the table rows for 1516 and 1517 and the word "Lulo" and the notes lines end mid-word. Marks * and † before the years are printed beside them. The word "Piepus" in the last note line is set in a different, black-letter type. Marks † ‡ § stand at the start of their paragraphs in the column. The last paragraph changes from italic to roman type at "Geldros in Frisia occid." Left-edge fragments were left out.
